ideas.title: The Minnesota Fraud Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged fraud scheme involving Minnesota officials, including the involvement of Governor Tim Walz and the Attorney General.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the flow of funds involved in the alleged fraud scheme.
questions: What was the nature of the scheme?
How did the officials get involved?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves a large amount of money and high-ranking officials, potentially indicating a significant abuse of power.
